input_rendering.REPLY_TEXT: The reply's visible text blocks, in order, joined with a blank line. No thinking, no citations, no ID, no date, no role label.

choice_question.rule: A multiple-choice question stored as a tool call is rendered as text at its position in the reply, separated from the surrounding text by a blank line. Render every text the person saw, in display order. Do not render which option was chosen or anything the person typed.
choice_question.several_questions: One block per question, in order, separated by a blank line.
choice_question.multi_select: If more than one option could be selected, use the line 'Options (more than one may be chosen):' in place of 'Options:'.
choice_question.same_for_all: Apply the same rendering to every reply in the pool that has such a question.

batch_notes.passes: Two requests per reply, identical except for custom_id. No conversation history, no tools.
batch_notes.custom_id: Must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ and be unique within the batch. The model does not see it.
batch_notes.results: Results come back in any order: match on custom_id.
batch_notes.test_first: Batch requests are validated only after the batch ends, and the batch docs do not name output_config. Send one synchronous request with these params before the first batch.
batch_notes.sampling: Do not send temperature, top_p or top_k: this model rejects non-default values.
batch_notes.thinking: Do not send a thinking field: adaptive thinking is always on for this model and cannot be disabled.
batch_notes.failed_call: A result that is errored or expired, a stop_reason of 'refusal' or 'max_tokens', or JSON that fails the schema is a failed call. Resend it; do not record it as UNCLEAR.
